education_subtitle: Learn, understand and actively participate in life in Austria
learning_language_subtitle: German and education as the key to everyday life
learning_language_help_desc: German is important for everyday life, school, work and contact with authorities.
learning_language_help_daily_desc: German helps you in everyday life, for example when shopping or going to the doctor.
learning_language_help_school_desc: German is important for school, training and learning.
learning_language_help_work_desc: Good knowledge of German will help you in your professional life.
learning_language_help_authorities_desc: German helps when speaking to offices and authorities.
learning_language_courses_desc: German courses at levels A1 to A2.
learning_language_adults_desc: German and educational courses especially for adults.
learning_language_everyday_desc: German for everyday situations such as doctor's visits, appointments and shopping.
learning_language_age_desc: Learning is possible at any age.
learning_language_places_desc: German courses in Upper Austria, Vienna and other federal states.
learning_language_free_desc: Many courses are free or subsidized.
learning_language_online_desc: Online exercises, videos and digital learning materials.
education_school_subtitle: This is how the education system works
education_school_duty_desc: In Austria, school attendance is compulsory from the age of 6.
education_primary_desc: Elementary school lasts from 6 to 10 years.
education_secondary_desc: After elementary school, children attend a middle school or an AHS.
education_after14_desc: Apprenticeship, AHS upper level or vocational school (BHS).
education_registration_desc: Registration takes place at the school or community in your place of residence.
education_documents_desc: Registration form, birth certificate and passport or residence permit.
education_support_desc: Children with little German receive additional language support.
education_adults_courses_desc: Courses for further training and qualification.
education_adults_support_desc: Advice on educational paths and recognition of qualifications.
democracy_subtitle: How we decide and live together
democracy_definition_desc: Democracy means that people decide together how they live together.
democracy_rights_desc: People are allowed to express their opinions, vote and have a say.
democracy_decisions_desc: Important decisions arise through elections, discussions and votes.
democracy_daily_desc: Democracy exists in the family, at school, at work and in coexistence.
democracy_participation_desc: Have a say, listen and find solutions together.
democracy_info_desc: Information about democracy in easy language.
education_summary_desc: Education, language and democracy will help you find your way in Austria.
